# Harjot Singh (D): NYS Senate, District 2

<!-- Generated by build.py from meta.json and claims.csv. Do not edit by hand. -->

Independent, source-by-source review of the claims on **Harjot Singh's** campaign website ([campaign home page (About and Priorities sections)](https://harjotfornewyork.com/)), captured **2026-11-26**. Opponent: [Mario Mattera](../mattera-mario/) (R).

**Live site:** <https://rike4545.github.io/LI-CandidateCheck/#/c/singh-harjot> · method: [METHODOLOGY.md](../../METHODOLOGY.md)

> Scope: this review tests whether each claim is **verifiable** and **accurate as stated**. It does not rate the candidate, the opponent, or policy positions.

## Bottom line

A short, biography-led page with few checkable claims. His law practice is documented; the personal details have no public record, and the one factual premise (rising nitrate) is supported.

1. His firm, the Law Offices of Harjot Singh PC, is listed with the practice areas the page names, though its office is in Hicksville rather than the district.
2. Education, residence and family details rest on the campaign's word; no public record was found either way.
3. The page's statement that nitrate in local water is increasing matches USGS trend data for Suffolk public-supply wells.
